avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer; significantly reduces cabozantinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; use alternative herbal products if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer; dramatically decreases cabozantinib levels
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; consult oncologist for alternative antimicrobial therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; increases cabozantinib bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid all grapefruit products and supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Hypericum perforatum (St. John's Wort)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces cabozantinib efficacy below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue; notify oncologist before use of any herbal products

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 inhibition; may slightly increase cabozantinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; report to healthcare team

caution_supplements.name: Curcumin/Turmeric supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4 modulating effects; limited clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and inform oncologist; monitor tolerability

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential modest CYP3A4 induction; may marginally reduce drug levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit duration of use; discuss with care team

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases cabozantinib plasma concentration and adverse event risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; choose alternative citrus fruits

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase cabozantinib exposure
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or limit consumption; monitor for toxicity signs

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase cabozantinib absorption and GI side effects; consistent food state improves bioavailability predictability
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain uniform dosing schedule

caution_foods.name: Charbroiled vegetables
caution_foods.mechanism: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons may modestly induce CYP metabolism
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance needed; consume in moderation

monitoring_notes: Cabozantinib is highly dependent on CYP3A4 metabolism; avoid all strong CYP3A4 inducers and inhibitors to maintain therapeutic drug levels. Monitor for signs of toxicity (diarrhea, hand-foot skin reaction, hypertension) and efficacy; dose adjustments may be required if significant interactions occur.
